title: Blossom Bloom Match
description: Sort vibrant roses, sunflowers, and tulips across sunny wooden garden shelves—pair three identical blossoms in a pot to clear dazzling floral combos.
controls: Drag flowers from pot to pot to group three matching blossoms together and clear every shelf before the timer runs out.

zh-CN.title: 花朵消除
zh-CN.description: 超治愈爆款三消花艺收纳：拖动玫瑰、向日葵、郁金香归类进同色花盆，三朵凑齐瞬间绽放消除超解压！
zh-CN.controls: 拖动不同花盆里的花朵进行整理，同一花盆集齐三朵相同花朵即可消除通关。
